docset:AgreementType.dg:chunk: ONTARIO ETHANE & GANTRY INFRASTRUCTURE LP, as Borrower
docset:AgreementType.docset:LenderOrAgentEntityName: JOVIAN-SATURNINE COLONIAL DEVELOPMENT CONSORTIUM (JSCDC), as Administrative Agent, Collateral Agent, and Lead Arranger
docset:AgreementType.dg:chunk: THE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS PARTY HERETO FROM TIME TO TIME, as Lenders

This SECURED TERM CREDIT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into on the Agreement Effective Date by and among Ontario Ethane & Gantry Infrastructure LP, as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto from time to time, and Jovian-Saturnine Colonial Development Consortium, as Administrative Agent. In consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties hereto agree as follows:
docset:AgreementType.docset:FacilityName: WHEREAS, the Borrower owns and operates a comprehensive shoreline and marine liquid ethane ($C_2H_6$) fractionation facility and carbon-nanotube high-altitude orbital export gantry situated on the southern shore of Ontario Lacus on Titan; and
docset:AgreementType.dg:chunk: WHEREAS, the Borrower has requested that the Lenders make term loans to finance shoreline piping systems, dynamic centrifuge fractionation towers, high-tension carbon-nanotube line arrays, and active docking gantries; and the Lenders are willing to do so on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslategray

docset:DefinedTerms.docset:DefinedTerms: As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings specified below:

dg:chunk.docset:DefinedTerms: • "Agreement Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement has been fully executed and delivered by all parties hereto, as verified by the date inscribed next to the signatures of the authorized officers in the execution block below (such date, the "Signature Date").

• "Ethane Purity Index" or "EPI" means the standard chemical composition rating of processed liquid ethane feedstock, as certified on a 100-point scale by the Titan Technical Safety Directorate (TTSD).
• "Gantry Tension Stability Rating" or "GTSR" means the structural, thermodynamic, and mechanical tension rating of the carbon-nanotube orbital delivery lines, as evaluated by the TTSD.
• "Lacus Sediment Escrow" means the cash escrow reserve fund mandated to be maintained under Section 4.01(3) for benthic lakebed stabilization and shoreline pressure containment.

• "Ontario Lacus Facility" means the physical structural pipelines, high-altitude carbon-nanotube siphoning lines, fractional distillation units, and lakebed intake valves located at Sector 36, Ontario Lacus coordinates (latitude 72.0° S, longitude 80.0° W) on Titan, Saturn.
• "Sol System Interstellar Accounting Standards" or "SSIAS" means the unified framework of financial accounting principles approved by the Interstellar Financial Board.
• "TIDOR" means the Titan Inter-Dome Offered Rate, which is the floating interbank benchmark rate calculated for Titan-denominated credit lines.

docset:AccountingOrInterpretationRules.docset:AccountingOrInterpretationRules: Capitalized terms defined in the singular shall have the corresponding meanings in the plural, and vice versa. Any references to specific sections, tables, or documents relate directly to this Agreement unless otherwise specified.

docset:CreditFacilityCommitment.dg:chunk: ARTICLE II: THE SECURED CREDIT LINES

docset:CreditFacilityCommitment.docset:CreditFacilityCommitment: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, each Lender agrees to make a single advance term loan (each a "Facility Loan") to the Borrower on the Closing Date (which is identical to the Signature Date) in an aggregate principal amount of 9,600,000,000 Sol Credits (SC).

dg:chunk.dg:chunk: 1 The Facility Loans shall accrue interest daily at a floating rate per annum equal to TIDOR plus 8.25%.

2 Should the Gantry Tension Stability Rating (GTSR) fall below 91.0% for any consecutive 3-day Titan cycle, the floating margin shall automatically increase by 3.75% per annum (the "Orbital Load Alignment Risk Premium") until the GTSR is restored to 94.0% or above, as verified by the TTSD.

docset:RepaymentSchedule.docset:RepaymentSchedule: Repayment of the principal shall be executed in equal quarterly installments on the final operational day of each Martian fiscal quarter, starting on the first such date following the Agreement Effective Date, in accordance with the amortization schedules appended hereto.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslategray

docset:RepresentationsAndWarranties.dg:chunk: The Borrower represents and warrants to the Lenders that:

docset:ExtractionOrOperatingRights.dg:chunk: Section 3.01 Shoreline and Underlake Mining Rights
docset:ExtractionOrOperatingRights.docset:ExtractionOrOperatingRights: The Borrower holds exclusive licenses to harvest, siphon, and refine liquid hydrocarbon mixtures within Sector 36-Ontario Lacus under the authority of the Titan Regulatory Council (TRC).

docset:StructuralOrEnvironmentalToleranc.dg:chunk: Section 3.02 Gantry Tension and Dynamic Wind Tolerances
docset:StructuralOrEnvironmentalToleranc.docset:StructuralOrEnvironmentalToleranc: The high-tension carbon-nanotube lines are equipped with electromagnetic recoil dampening modules designed to stabilize cargo lines against high-altitude jet stream forces exceeding 160 meters per second.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslategray

docset:AffirmativeCovenants.dg:chunk: So long as any part of the Facility Loan remains outstanding, the Borrower shall:

dg:chunk.docset:MaintenanceCovenant: 1 Piping and Line Maintenance: Undertake continuous acoustic-imaging diagnostics of the primary shoreline pipeline casing and orbital cargo lines to ensure the GTSR does not fall below the base standard of 92.0%.
dg:chunk.docset:AffirmativeCovenants: 2 Maintain Composition Purity: Operate the fractionation centrifuge towers to sustain the processed liquid ethane within an Ethane Purity Index of 98.5% or above, ensuring supply covenants with orbital spacecraft propellant collectors are satisfied.

3 Lacus Sediment Escrow Account: Maintain the cash-funded Lacus Sediment Escrow with the Administrative Agent, holding a balance of not less than SC 600,000,000 at all times to manage ocean-floor structural anchoring stability.

docset:NegativeCovenants.dg:chunk: The Borrower shall not, without the explicit written approval of the Administrative Agent:

dg:chunk.docset:SystemModificationProhibition: 1 System Modifications: Reroute or depressurize the structural pipelines of any active secondary fractionators within the designated coordinates.
dg:chunk.docset:NegativeCovenants: 2 Restricted Payments: Declare or make any dividend distributions to corporate parent entities if the GTSR is below 93.0% or if a Default Event has occurred and is continuing.

docset:DefaultArticle.dg:chunk: ARTICLE V: DEFAULT EVENTS AND REMEDIES

docset:EventOfDefault.dg:chunk: The occurrence of any of the following events shall constitute an Event of Default:

dg:chunk.docset:PrimaryDefaultEvent: 1 Cargo Line Decoupling or Backlash: Any structural line failure resulting in high-altitude cargo decoupling, causing catastrophic dynamic backlash of carbon-nanotube arrays and severe shoreline platform damage.
dg:chunk.docset:EventOfDefault: 2 Covenant Non-Compliance: Failure to maintain the required balance in the Lacus Sediment Escrow under Section 4.01(3), or failure to meet the Ethane Purity Index baseline standard of 98.0% for more than two consecutive quarters.

3 Sub-surface Ice Deconsolidation: Any localized shoreline sub-surface heating adjacent to the primary pipeline anchors causing structural ice bedrock temperatures to exceed 242 Kelvin, threatening the structural alignment of the gantry gantry.
